findings.claim: The change deliberately generates a formatter for a type from a referenced assembly via GeneratedFormatterCollector, which looks like it contradicts the metadata-only early return in TypeCollector.CollectCore. Ledger L11 records that the normal TypeCollector path skips metadata types deliberately, and this is a separate opt-in path, so it is not a defect.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] Types from a referenced assembly get no formatter from the normal TypeCollector path; the explicit [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] opt-in is a separate collector, so no conflict.

findings.claim: Contractless mode serializes only public read-write members and needs no [MessagePackObject]. This looks like it contradicts the explicit-annotation default, but the requirement's maintainer comment explicitly asks for contractless-by-default for this attribute, so it is consistent with L8 (default stays explicit for normal types).

receipt_plan.detail: [L8]/[L3] Explicit annotation is the default for normal types; REQ-2129 maintainer note authorises contractless for this opt-in attribute.

findings.claim: The attribute docs and README say existing MessagePack attributes on T are honoured, yet the implementation never reads [Key], [IgnoreMember], [DataContract] or [MessagePackObject] from T. When there is no surrogate it always goes contractless. This misses the acceptance criterion "If T does carry MessagePack attributes, they are honoured" (the README does not mention this limitation).

receipt_plan.detail: Add an execution test with a formatted type that has [MessagePackObject] and [Key(0)]/[IgnoreMember] members; assert the generated formatter emits an int-key array and skips ignored members. Currently it emits a string-key map.

findings.claim: The new diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are Errors, and the feature adds public API (GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute) to MessagePack.Annotations. No PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt update appears in the diff, which is a convention violation for a public API addition.

receipt_plan.detail: Check whether src/MessagePack.Annotations has PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt, and whether it lists GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute and SurrogateType.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Implements the surrogate-type design plus contractless default: [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter(SurrogateType=typeof(X))]. Keys come only from the surrogate, with no attribute reading on T. Contractless uses sorted string keys.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless-only, but honours attributes already on T. The generator reads [MessagePackObject]/[Key]/[DataContract] on the external type and uses them when present. There is no SurrogateType property and no surrogate matching code or MsgPack022.
